relay_parity.signed account deletion: The reference durably queues a verified Clerk user.deleted event and acknowledges it with an empty 200. Ferrum has no configured account-deletion handler and returns RelayInternalError.

github_provider_parity.issue planning statuses: For a repository with planning statuses, the reference returns the current status, allowed choices and viewerCanSetStatus. Ferrum uses the legacy open/closed states and close/reopen permission.
